summary: Round 3, TESTS ONLY, on the 25-case suite in buildSrc/src/test/java/binjava/IoSeamGateTest.java and IoSeamLexerTest.java. Everything below was MEASURED in a throwaway detached git worktree under the session scratchpad (never the live tree), the staged patch applied with `git apply --index`, each mutation applied to scripts/io_seam_scan.py, the suite re-run with `./gradlew -p buildSrc test --tests 'binjava.IoSeam*'`, and the scanner restored from a pristine copy between runs. Baseline 25/25 green. THIRTEEN MUTATIONS RUN, TEN KILLED, THREE SURVIVED. THE SUITE IS MUCH STRONGER THAN THE ONE I REVIEWED AT 7b7bc940 AND EVERY ONE OF MY EARLIER FINDINGS IS CLOSED, VERIFIED BY MUTATION RATHER THAN BY READING: T1 (thirteen of sixteen deny-list entries deletable) is closed by construction -- everyBANNEDConstructIsREFUSED asserts its 48-row sample table equals io_seam_scan.ALL_ENTRIES with containsExactlyInAnyOrder, so deleting ANY entry from PACKAGES, BANNED or ALLOWED reds the case before a fixture is even written; T2 (char literal blinds the scanner) -- mutation `elif src[i] in '\"\\''` -> `elif src[i] == '\"'` KILLED; T3 (multi-line comment) -- mutation making the block-comment branch run to EOF KILLED, and the quoting fixture now carries a multi-line javadoc, a line comment, a string AND a text block; T1-r3 (line-comment branch to EOF) KILLED; T2-r3 (drop the escape step in the string/char branch) KILLED; T3-r3 (`new` qualifier `*` -> `+`) reds everyBANNEDConstructIsREFUSED, because the `new ProcessBuilder(` sample is deliberately UNQUALIFIED -- verified at scanner level. ALSO KILLED, so I am not raising them: text-block escape step dropped; `_allowed_at`'s prefix test reversed (`a.startswith(name)`), which would admit java.net.URL through java.net.URLEncoder; the `.now()` arity arm `\\(\\s*\\)` -> `\\(`, which would refuse LocalDate.now(clock); and `for path in paths` -> `paths[:1]`, the partial-read mutation. everyBANNEDConstructIsREFUSED is NOT vacuous: the empty-body control genuinely pins the fixture signature, and each refusal asserts the REPORTED CONSTRUCT (`.contains(e.getKey())`) rather than only exit 1, so a sample refused by the wrong entry does not pass. The two remaining majors are the same shape as each other and as everything this task has found: a branch of the matcher that carries an explicit MEASURED claim in the production docstring and has no case behind it, so it can be deleted with 25/25 green. Each is one fixture, not a redesign. Tree left as found: `git diff --cached | sha256sum` still 5657d9890c34, `git status --short` unchanged, worktree removed.
